jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

The IT Operations team keeps Anthropic running. We make sure every employee can do their best work without friction. We're hiring an IT Operations Engineer to develop our global asset management and hardware lifecycle program across our offices in San Francisco, New York, Seattle, London, Dublin and Sydney. You will bring program expertise to how we track hardware as inventory through its whole life: procurement and receiving, the inventory of record, assignment, refresh, collection and recovery, e-waste and secure disposal, and reseller relationships, iterating and scaling practices as we mature. The same person runs day-to-day operations for our corporate mobile program in addition to expertise in management of laptop and workstation lifecycle operations.

You'll partner with several teams within the IT, Security and business operations organizations: IT Hardware Ops runs procurement, fleet logistics, onboarding and offboarding, the storage room, and physical intake. The Endpoint pod owns MDM, device policy and enrollment. Finance owns the budget and vendor contracts. Hardware requests that come through the IT Support queue land with the IT Support team, and you'll help define how they are handled.

Responsibilities

Strategy and Tooling

• Develop the global asset management strategy: the lifecycle model, the data we keep on every device, and how each office executes against it
• Select, implement and administer the asset management tool, define its data model and integrations, and partner with IT Engineering where the work needs platform-level access
• Contribute to and develop the processes on-site engineers in each office execute against, including the storage room process
• Support the evaluation and onboarding of a hardware lifecycle services vendor and, once in place, run the day-to-day relationship

Inventory and Assignment

• Establish the inventory of record across systems and keep it accurate, from receiving through disposal: every device, its state, its location, and who has it
• Run audits of who-has-what and reconcile physical counts against the system of record
• Manage demo, loaner, and travel device inventories, ensuring devices are accurately tracked through complex logistical deployments
• Maintain up-to-date inventory counts and make strategic purchasing decisions in support new hire onboarding and peripherals stock levels

Procurement and Refresh

• Support hardware purchasing through our reseller and vendor relationships, working from the refresh calendar
• Build out the refresh calendar and advance it across offices
• Reconcile purchase orders, deliveries and invoices with Accounting and vendors so that what was ordered, received, and billed line up

Collection, E-waste and Disposal

• Develop device collection and recovery workflows: offboarding returns, refresh swaps, remote-employee returns and the BPO fleet, including the shipping and tracking that goes with them
• Build the e-waste program: certified recycling and secure disposal partners in each region, data destruction records, and the chain of custody from collection to certificate
• Handle equipment under legal hold or other chain-of-custody requirements

BPO and Contingent Fleet

•

Provision, track and recover the device fleet for our BPO partners, and be the day-to-day hardware contact for those vendors

Corporate Mobile

• Run day-to-day operations for the corporate mobile program and write its runbook
• Manage deployment, break-fix, and carrier relationships associated with a mobile device fleet

Automation

•

Identify repetitive work throughout the operation and automate it with the tools at hand (scripts, systems integrations / connectors, AI tools)

You may be a good fit if you

• Have implemented an asset management and lifecycle program for a multi-office fleet, not only run one: taken it from spreadsheets or nothing to a system of record and defined the processes around it (procurement, inventory, assignment, refresh, collection and disposal), ideally in a fast-paced or high-growth environment
• Have selected or implemented an asset management platform such as Jira Assets, Snipe-IT or similar, and developed the data model
• Have run an e-waste or secure disposal program with certified partners and chain-of-custody records
• Have managed reseller or vendor relationships for hardware purchasing and asset disposal
• Write things down: runbooks, how-to guides and knowledge base articles
• Recognize when a request reaches past this role and route platform work to IT Engineering, policy to the Endpoint pod, and budget to Finance

Strong candidates may also

• Have supported a corporate mobile program or carrier account
• Have basic scripting experience (Bash or Python) for inventory or reporting automation
• Have experience using AI tools to improve personal or team productivity
• Have been the hands-on asset contact for an ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audit: pulled extracts from the register, produced disposal certificates and evidence of returned assets

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$180,000—$230,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

Company Introduction:
Coupang is reimagining the shopping experience with the goal of wowing each customer from the instant they open the Coupang app to the moment an order is delivered to their door.
Our services in Taiwan include “Rocket Delivery” which offers next-day delivery for a wide selection of items at affordable prices, “Rocket Oversea” which offers free international delivery on millions of best-selling products from Korea, the U.S., and beyond.
We are looking for talents to help us lead Coupang’s expansion in Taiwan. This is an exceptional opportunity to become a part of Coupang’s growth in Taiwan and create a world where our customers wonder, “How did I ever live without Coupang?”
Role Overview:
Data Analysts on the TW Logistics Analytics team
are responsible for understanding and improving the entire customer delivery journey—from order placement to final delivery (last-mile logistics)—through data-driven insights.
Specifically, they:
Build and maintain data infrastructure, including pipelines, data mart tables, and dashboards, to ensure stakeholders have access to accurate and timely data when they need it.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability through validation, backfilling, and governance processes.
Conduct deep-dive analyses to identify root causes behind operational issues and uncover actionable opportunities for improvement, going beyond surface-level metrics.
Partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Operations teams to develop innovative analytical approaches that enable insights and capabilities that were previously not possible.
What You Will Do:
End-to-End Delivery Operations Analytics
Define and monitor key KPIs related to the delivery network, delivery status, and courier operations, and identify the root causes of operational issues through data-driven analysis.
Track and analyze operational metrics such as delivery success rate, delivery lead time, and courier productivity, uncover improvement opportunities, and support data-driven decision-making within the Operations organization.
New Project Simulation & Pre-/Post-Launch Analysis
Evaluate the impact of new initiatives, such as route optimization and network redesign, through rigorous pre- and post-launch data analysis.
Design simulation frameworks and provide accurate, actionable insights to help decision-makers make informed business decisions.
Data Infrastructure & Governance
Design, build, and maintain the data pipelines (Airflow DAGs) and data mart tables (Hive/Presto) that serve as the foundation for delivery-domain analytics.
Ensure data integrity and reliability through validation, backfilling, and governance processes, while maintaining a trusted data ecosystem.
KPI Reporting & Stakeholder Communication
Develop and manage business reports and dashboards for leadership teams and key stakeholders.
Communicate analytical findings clearly and concisely to diverse audiences, fostering a data-driven decision-making culture across the organization.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with Product Managers, Program Managers, Engineers, and Operations teams to translate business questions into analytical frameworks and deliver timely, actionable insights.
Essential Qualifications
3+ years of experience analyzing large-scale datasets using SQL (Presto/Hive).
Experience developing data ETL processes and orchestrating data pipelines (e.g., Airflow).
Experience building dashboards and business reports using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Zeppelin.
Strong ability to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve data quality and validation issues.
Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional environments with Engineering, Product, and Operations teams.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to clearly present analytical findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
Business proficiency in Mandarin Chinese.
Intermediate English proficiency, including reading, writing, and verbal communication.
Preferred Qualifications:
Knowledge of logistics and delivery operations, including last-mile delivery, delivery network design, and Warehouse Management Systems (WMS).
Understanding of statistical methodologies, including A/B testing and causal inference.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis, automation, and workflow optimization.
Experience working with diverse data systems in global and multi-market environments.
Proven track record of leading end-to-end analytics projects, from problem definition and analysis design to insight generation and decision support.
Experience leveraging AI/ML tools (e.g., LLM-based coding assistants, Generative AI) to improve analytics workflows, such as automated query generation, accelerated pipeline development, and automated insight summarization.
Business proficiency in English.

## Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Embark on a career putting innovative, reliable, and agile products and ideas into orbit, and beyond. Northrop Grumman has opportunities waiting for you that play a vital role in human space exploration, national defense, and scientific discovery, supporting multiple programs across the universe.

Northrop Grumman Space Systems is seeking a highly qualified and energetic leader for the position of Manager 1 Supply Chain Programs to join our team in Dulles, VA.

This is an onsite position. No relocation will be provided. This position’s standard work schedule is a 9/80. The 9/80 schedule allows employees who work a nine-hour day Monday through Thursday to take every other Friday off.

This individual will be responsible and accountable for the planning and execution of the supply chain strategy for all material and services content for a Program or portfolio of Programs.

Key responsibilities include program planning (i.e. developing a procurement plan for subcontracts and material while aligning Global Supply Chain (GSC) resources to meet that plan), supply chain metrics (i.e. on-time to place, on-time to need), supplier performance (i.e. line of balance, material status, supplier risk/opportunity management), and financial management (i.e. budget, sales forecasting of subcontract milestones and material).

The GSC PM will lead teams to ensure the placement and receipt of all material requirements support the program plan. If anything falls off plan, the GSC PM will be responsible to steer resources to address as appropriate. Acts as the main focal point for the Program Management Office (PMO) for the entire supply chain and coordinates cross-functionally to ensure that all supply chain commitments are met, and that appropriate mitigation plans are developed and executed to address any programmatic risks related to suppliers. Briefs the PMO and executive management on the status and issues affecting Program cost and schedule performance.

Additional duties:

### Program Supply Chain Execution & Subcontract Management

* Execute end-to-end material strategy and supply chain plans for assigned Development and Production Programs, aligning supply resources with customer requirements, corporate objectives, and product-line priorities
* Serve as the primary supply chain focal point for assigned Program Management Offices (PMOs), ensuring all supply chain commitments are met through proactive coordination across Subcontracts, Procurement, Engineering, Quality, Finance, Manufacturing, Contracts, and Operations
* Monitor and manage subcontract execution by tracking performance against Statement of Work (SOW) requirements, deliverable milestones, cost/schedule baselines, and compliance with contractual terms and conditions
* Develop and execute risk mitigation plans to address programmatic challenges related to supplier performance, material availability, lead time variability, and supply chain disruptions
* Manage financial forecasting and cost tracking for material purchases and subcontract obligations, coordinating with Finance and Business Management to align supplier invoice accruals and material delivery schedules with prime contract milestones, Estimate at Completion (EAC) projections, and program funding profiles to ensure accurate financial reporting and cash flow management
* Provide technical and analytical support to subcontract negotiations by developing should-cost models, conducting price/cost analysis, benchmarking supplier pricing against market rates, and identifying cost reduction opportunities without compromising quality or schedule performance

### Supplier Performance Management & Quality Oversight

* Manage supplier performance by tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) including on-time delivery (OTD), quality metrics (First-Pass Yield, defect rates, non-conformances), cost performance, and compliance with AS9100/NADCAP standards and ITAR/EAR requirements
* Conduct supplier business reviews (weekly/monthly/quarterly) to analyze supplier progression, delivery performance, spend patterns, and continuous improvement initiatives; prepare executive-level supplier performance reports and scorecards
* Support supplier corrective action processes by coordinating with Quality on Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCARs), monitoring containment actions, verifying root cause analysis, and tracking closure of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA)

### Engineering Qualification & Product Lifecycle Management

* Manage qualification subcontracts for new product introductions and supplier qualifications, partnering closely with Engineering to coordinate design reviews, qualification testing requirements, and technical assessments while ensuring Subcontract Data Requirements Lists (SDRLs) deliverables—including test plans, test reports, design data packages, and certification documentation—are tracked, reviewed, and submitted on schedule
* Oversee engineering-intensive qualification efforts by coordinating between suppliers, Engineering, Quality, and Mission Assurance during First Article Inspections (FAI), environmental testing, structural testing, performance validation, and reliability qualification cycles to ensure all technical requirements and acceptance criteria are met
* Conduct make-vs-buy analyses and provide strategic recommendations based on total cost of ownership, supplier technical capabilities, qualification risk assessments, capacity constraints, and sourcing considerations for development and production programs
* Manage product lifecycle transitions including phase-in/phase-out activities, manufacturing ramp-up/ramp-down following successful qualification, and end-of-life (EOL) material planning in coordination with Sourcing, Operations, Finance, and Engineering

### Proposal & Business Acquisition Support

* Develop comprehensive supply chain strategies for proposal activities, including Basis of Estimates (BOEs), material forecasts, supplier identification, make/buy plans, risk assessments, and procurement strategies for new business opportunities
* Participate in Business Acquisition Process (BAP) activities and gate reviews, ensuring proposed program plans have complete and accurate schedules, budgets, resource plans, and subcontracting strategies that are executable and competitive
* Provide rapid-response proposal support for quick-turn capture efforts, including competitive cost analysis, teaming arrangements, and supplier capability assessments

### Strategic Planning, Reporting & Program Controls

* Prepare and deliver executive-level briefings on supply chain performance, supplier scorecards, program risks, mitigation strategies, and cost/schedule impacts to senior leadership and Program Directors during Program Management Reviews (PMRs)
* Develop data-driven insights and analytics using ERP, Cognos, and business intelligence tools to identify trends, support decision-making, and recommend process improvements that enhance supply chain efficiency and reduce costs
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by championing Lean/Six Sigma methodologies, process optimization, and best-in-class procurement practices to increase operational excellence

Basic Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree
* Minimum 6 years of supply chain, program management, procurement, purchasing or closely related experience
* At least 2 years of lead or supervisory experience
* Knowledge of general procurement and subcontract execution workflows
* Understanding of general manufacturing and purchasing workflows
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a security clearance

Preferred Qualifications:

* Currently holds an active SCI security clearance
* Experience in the Aerospace/Defense/Space industry
* Understanding of forecasting and planning with an emphasis on driving execution to need with an emphasis on working knowledge of Integrated Master Schedules
* Experience working with multiple complex contracting types and agreements, including Firm Fixed Price and Cost Reimbursable, and possess knowledge relating to special payment provisions (progress of performance base payments).
* In-depth experience with proposal process, pricing instructions, terms and conditions and evaluating the adequacy of subcontractor proposals received.

Primary Level Salary Range: $121,000.00 - $181,600.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. jobs.description: AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset. Amazon WorkSpaces has protected and empowered enterprise work for over a decade and we are now reimagining what a workspace is. We are building Agentic WorkSpaces: a platform where the workspace itself is an active partner in how you work not just infrastructure that delivers applications. Today more than a million users rely on WorkSpaces daily; tomorrow those workspaces will host AI agents alongside humans agents that code, troubleshoot, analyze, and act on behalf of their users governed by the same identity and security policies as the people they serve. We compete with Microsoft Citrix and Omnissa and we intend to leapfrog them by building the workspace that was designed for the agentic era not retrofitted for it. Agentic WorkSpaces' Data Plane is the connective tissue that makes this possible: the single entry point through which every WorkSpaces connection flows and the streaming backbone that delivers the desktop experience once a session begins. We own the end-to-end pre-session journey authentication across every identity method, session authorization, resource discovery, gateway selection, and cross-region failover as well as the in-session streaming stack that carries pixels to the user and the pipeline that delivers workspace health and performance metrics back to our customers. Our vision is for that connection to be seamless and invisible: users and the agents working beside them reach their workspace instantly and securely sessions stream with high fidelity and low latency failover is transparent and the health of every connection is observable through the same AWS tools customers already use delivered reliably from commercial regions to classified partitions at a scale where availability and security are non-negotiable. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to design build and operate the services that authenticate authorize connect and stream WorkSpaces sessions for humans and increasingly for the AI agents that work beside them across every supported identity provider and streaming protocol. You will own end-to-end delivery of features and systems within the Data Plane from design through deployment and operations holding a high bar for availability latency and security on the services that stand between every customer and their workspace. You are customer-obsessed technically deep and energized by solving hard problems. You think big about what the workspace of the future looks like a connection fabric that treats humans and agents as first-class principals streaming that adapts intelligently to network conditions and brokering that routes and heals itself before users notice a problem and then you build the systems to get there. You thrive in ambiguity make sound trade-off decisions with incomplete information and hold yourself accountable for results that matter. You want to solve challenging problems in distributed systems identity real-time streaming and network infrastructure at a scale that impacts more than a million users daily. Key job responsibilities • Design and deliver features and systems within the Data Plane contributing to the architecture strategy for how the connection and streaming layer evolves to broker and stream sessions for AI agents alongside human users. • Drive the work that unifies and simplifies how sessions are brokered and streamed across protocols making a consistent high-fidelity connection experience the default. Partner with compute identity providers networking and gateway teams earning trust by driving technical discussions that result in impactful architectural decisions. • Design and implement pre-session authentication authorization and governance for a world where humans and agents share the same connection path: identity integration across every authentication method session authorization and access policies that treat agents as first-class principals and a security posture built in rather than bolted on. • Own the operation of low-latency high-availability brokering and streaming services that are the single entry point for more than one million WorkSpaces users globally. Ensure your services meet stringent SLAs across multiple production regions AWS partitions and streaming protocols with self-healing routing transparent cross-region failover and autonomous issue resolution before customers are impacted. • Drive engineering excellence through instrumentation automated testing and pipeline-based deployment eliminating manual toil and delivering a consistent connection and streaming experience across every protocol. Think big about the agentic era and experiment boldly with AI-powered capabilities such as intelligent gateway selection self-diagnosing connections and AI-assisted operational management. • Raise the bar on connection reliability and observability so that authentication session brokering high-fidelity streaming and customer-facing metrics are delivered without imposing an operational tax on the customer or the agent workflows running on the desktop. About the team Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud. Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Job Description

The Director, Cyber Risk Advisory is responsible for designing and delivering strategic cyber risk solutions that help clients strengthen security, enhance resilience, and achieve business objectives. The role assesses cyber risk across people, processes, technology, data, and third-party ecosystems, advising clients on emerging threats, regulatory requirements, governance, and risk management strategies.

Partnering closely with clients and cross-functional stakeholders, you will help develop innovative solutions that address complex security challenges and builds trusted advisor relationships. Through strategic consulting and thought leadership, the role helps position Visa as a leader in Cyber Risk, Operational Resilience, Third-Party Risk Management, Cyber Governance, and Digital Trust.

Key Responsibilities:

• Design and lead tailored Cyber Risk management and Cyber Resilience advisory engagements that help clients strengthen their Cyber risk posture, meet regulatory expectations, and achieve measurable business outcomes.
• Assess clients' end-to-end cyber and fraud risk ecosystems, identifying vulnerabilities across people, processes, technology, and third-party dependencies, and develop actionable transformation roadmaps.
• Partner with data, product, technology, and client-facing teams to develop scalable cyber risk frameworks, risk assessment methodologies, and industry-specific consulting propositions.
• Advise financial institutions, fintechs, merchants, and public sector organizations on emerging cyber threats, AI and digital identity risks, and evolving regulatory requirements.
• Develop and deliver innovative solutions leveraging advanced analytics, AI, automation, and risk intelligence to improve cyber resilience and operational effectiveness.
• Cultivate a risk-first, client-centric culture within the advisory practice, ensuring solutions balance security, customer experience, regulatory compliance, and commercial outcomes.
• Lead strategic client engagements, executive workshops, and board-level discussions, helping clients prioritize investments, quantify risk exposure, and build long-term cyber resilience capabilities.
• Collaborate with Account Executives and regional sales teams to identify growth opportunities, develop value propositions, support business development efforts, and drive practice revenue through advisory engagements, managed services, and solution-led consulting.
• Build and scale new advisory offerings across Cyber Risk, Third-Party Risk, Digital Trust, and AI Risk Governance, ensuring alignment with market demand and Visa's broader risk strategy.
• Develop trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, regulators, technology partners, and ecosystem providers to position Visa as a strategic advisor and thought leader in cyber risk management.
• Leverage emerging technologies, including Generative AI and Agentic AI capabilities, to enhance consulting delivery, accelerate risk assessments, improve threat intelligence analysis, and drive scalable client outcomes.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

• 12+ years of work experience with a Bachelor's Degree, or Advanced Degree (e.g., Master's/MBA).
• Proven experience in leading and delivering Cyber Risk consulting and advisory engagements for large enterprises, financial institutions, fintechs, or technology organizations.
• Experience conducting cyber risk assessments, cyber maturity reviews, security strategy development, and risk transformation programs aligned to business objectives.
• Deep understanding of cybersecurity frameworks, standards, and regulatory requirements, including NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, SWIFT CSCF, and regional regulatory expectations.

jobs.description: Instandhaltungs- und Wartungstechnik, kurz RME. Tief im Herzen von Amazon entwickelt und pflegt das RME-Team Spitzentechnologien, die es uns ermöglichen, die Ausrüstung und Prozesse der Zukunft zu gestalten. Sie setzen sich bei jedem Schritt des Prozesses leidenschaftlich für Innovation ein. Sie sind auch diejenigen, die dauerhafte Qualität und Verfügbarkeit unserer Anlagen sicherstellen. An jedem Amazon-Standort arbeitet dieses Team an etwa drei technischen Innovationsprojekten pro Jahr. Wenn Du neugierig geworden bist, Deine Engineering-Reise zu beginnen, kreativ arbeiten möchtest um unsere Prozesse jedes Jahr reibungsloser, schneller und effizienter zu machen, dann trete dem Amazon RME-Team bei. Der Schwerpunkt dieser Rolle liegt auf der Durchführung grundlegender Wartungsarbeiten an einer Vielzahl von Anlagen am Standort. Dazu gehören die Maschinenwartungen, der Austausch von Teilen gemäß den Wartungshandbüchern und Tests unter Einhaltung der Sicherheitsvorschriften und -richtlinien. Dies ist Deine Gelegenheit, in die Welt von RME einzusteigen. Make it count. Key job responsibilities • Durchführung vorbeugender Wartungsprüfungen an einer Vielzahl von Anlagen • Austausch von Ersatzteilen an Anlagen gemäß Standardbetriebsverfahren (standortabhängig). • Verwendung von Laptop/Tablet zur Verwaltung von Arbeitsaufträgen • Verwendung von üblichen Werkzeugen • Gewährleistung eines sicheren und sauberen Arbeitsplatzes während und nach der Durchführung der Arbeiten. Die Stelle beinhaltet die Arbeit in einem rotierenden Dreischichtsystem, welches Samstage, Nachtschichten sowie Rufbereitschaft umfassen kann. Zudem besteht das Logistiknetzwerk in der Region aus mehreren Standorten, welche im Notfall eine Mitbetreuung voraussetzen. Lokale Flexibilität und eine gewisse Reisebereitschaft (innerhalb der Region) sollte dementsprechend gegeben sein. A day in the life In dieser Position unterstützt Du die Wartung und Instandhaltung unserer Förder- und Gebäudetechnik sowie Produktionsanlagen in unserem Logistikzentrum. Gemeinsam mit dem technischen Team stellst Du durch ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative und dem notwendigen technischen Know-how eine hohe Verfügbarkeit der technischen Anlagen sicher. Du arbeitest in rotierenden Schichten, damit wir rund um die Uhr unsere Standorte unterstützen – und dafür sorgen, dass Amazon weiterhin in dem Tempo liefern kann, für das wir bekannt sind. About the team Mit der Erfüllung unserer Kundenbestellungen (Customer Fulfillment oder CF) fing für Amazon alles an. Das Customer Fulfillment Team hat sich mittlerweile von einem bescheidenen Team von Buchhändler:innen hin zu einem hocherfahrenen globalen Team gewandelt, das täglich mehr als 1,5 Millionen Bestellungen bearbeitet. Das Team bildet die Grundlage unseres Geschäfts und hat uns bei der Verbreiterung in neue Regionen und Dienstleistungen geholfen. Mithilfe aufkommender Technologie sind wir laufend auf der Suche nach Möglichkeiten, eine größere und bessere Produktauswahl anzubieten – die schnell und erschwinglich geliefert wird. Die CF-Teammitglieder sorgen als allererste dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen mit der Geschwindigkeit erhalten, für die wir bekannt sind. Wir arbeiten in Fulfillment-Centern, die das Herzstück von Amazons dynamischem Betriebsnetz bilden. Unsere Fullfilment-Center werden manchmal auch als die „erste Meile“ (First Mile) bezeichnet – hier starten die meisten Amazon-Pakete ihren Versandweg. Wir unterstützen die Verwaltung eines dynamischen Bestands und ermöglichen schnelle Zustellungen rund um die Uhr. In unseren Fulfillment-Centern sind vielfältige Mitarbeitergruppen beschäftigt. Es gibt zahlreiche Möglichkeiten für Menschen mit den verschiedensten Fähigkeiten. Einige von uns arbeiten mit physischen Produkten. Andere analysieren Daten und helfen unternehmensweit dabei, intelligente Entscheidungen zu treffen. Alle unsere Aktivitäten sind darauf ausgerichtet, die Ausfallzeiten an Amazons wichtigsten Betriebsstandorten zu reduzieren, damit Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen rechtzeitig erhalten. Oft arbeiten wir früh morgens, spät abends oder in der Nachtschicht, um Wartungsarbeiten mit den geringstmöglichen Störungen vorzunehmen.

회사 소개

쿠팡파이낸셜(CFN)은 아시아에서 가장 큰 리테일러 중 하나인 쿠팡의 계열사로, 금융 부문에서 고객 만족 최우선(Wow the Customer)의 경험을 선사하는 기업입니다.

혁신적인 금융 상품과 서비스를 통해 국내 금융 시장의 포용적 성장을 이끌어 나갈 쿠팡파이낸셜의 여정이 궁금하시다면, 지금 바로 합류하세요!

팀 소개 및 업무 내용

쿠팡파이낸셜(CFN)의 Lending Engineering팀은 쿠팡 생태계에서 제공되는 다양한 금융 서비스를 개발하고 운영하는 조직입니다. 팀의 백엔드 엔지니어는 고객에게 세계에서 가장 편리한 금융 경험을 제공하기 위해 금융 플랫폼과 핵심 서비스를 설계, 개발 및 운영합니다.

대규모 거래 데이터를 처리하는 금융 시스템을 구축하고, 데이터 정합성과 시스템 안정성을 바탕으로 고객이 신뢰할 수 있는 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 Product, Business, Finance 및 다양한 엔지니어링 팀과 협업하여 복잡한 금융 문제를 해결하고, 새로운 금융 서비스를 빠르게 시장에 선보이는 역할을 수행합니다.

CFN의 Lending Engineering팀은 고객 경험 향상과 기술 혁신을 동시에 추구합니다. 우리는 높은 수준의 안정성과 확장성을 갖춘 플랫폼을 구축하며, 쿠팡 생태계의 금융 서비스를 한 단계 더 발전시키는 여정을 함께할 엔지니어를 찾고 있습니다.

• English fluency for reading, communication, and collaboration

• Experience in translation, linguistic QA, localization coursework, or related academic fields

• Familiarity with localization workflows or content management tools is a plus

• A strong interest in gaming, cross-cultural communication, and in-language content quality

• Basic organizational skills and the ability to follow task guidelines and meet deadlines
